summary: Iteration 48 - Pulse Portal Major Rework Testing Complete. All features verified working: GymFix-style Tabs (not slider), Faults tab with filters and Log New Fault button, Settings dialog with Team Management accessible from Navbar, Portal Switcher in Master Admin sidebar. Backend APIs (10/10 tests passed) and Frontend UI (all flows verified via Playwright).

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - minor accessibility issue in dialogs

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pulse Portal rework complete. Key changes: 1) Horizontal slider nav replaced with GymFix-style Tabs component. 2) 'Log a Fault' tab renamed to 'Faults' showing all logged faults with status/severity filters. 3) Team Management moved to Settings dialog (accessible from Navbar user menu via data-testid='nav-settings-btn'). 4) Portal Switcher in Master Admin sidebar (data-testid='portal-switch-gymfix' and 'portal-switch-pulse-pro'). Tab IDs: lite-tab-{overview|equipment|faults|documents|check-sheets|ai-diagnosis|reports|gym-layout|weekly-digest}. Pulse login uses separate form: pulse-login-email, pulse-login-password, pulse-login-submit.

1_pulse_login_and_branding.notes: Pulse landing page shows 'Pulse Fitness' branding with blue wrench icon. Customer Login button (data-testid='pulse-login-btn') opens login modal. Login as test@gymfixai.com works correctly.

2_gymfix_style_tabs.notes: GymFix-style Tabs component (data-testid='pulse-dashboard-tabs') replaces old slider navigation. All 9 tabs visible for Pro owner: Overview, Equipment, Faults, Documents, Check Sheets, AI Diagnosis, Reports, Gym Layout, Weekly Digest.

3_faults_tab_list_view.notes: Faults tab (data-testid='lite-tab-faults') shows list of all logged faults with severity badges (Minor Issue, Fault Present, etc.) and status badges (Open, In Progress, Resolved).

4_faults_tab_log_new_fault_button.notes: 'Log New Fault' button (data-testid='log-fault-btn') opens fault logging dialog.

5_faults_tab_filters.notes: Status filter dropdown (data-testid='fault-filter-status') with All Statuses, Open, In Progress, Resolved. Severity filter dropdown (data-testid='fault-filter-severity') with all severity levels.

6_fault_logging_dialog.notes: Log Fault dialog (data-testid='log-fault-dialog') has machine select, description textarea, severity options, photo upload, and submit button.

7_overview_tab_kpi_cards.notes: Overview tab shows 4 KPI cards: Total Machines, Operational, With Faults, Open Faults. Also has 'Log a Fault' CTA button (data-testid='overview-log-fault-btn').

8_equipment_tab.notes: Equipment tab shows equipment list with search input (data-testid='lite-equip-search'). Click equipment to expand details.

9_documents_tab.notes: Documents tab (data-testid='documents-content') shows document list with view/download/delete buttons.

10_settings_from_navbar.notes: Settings accessible from Navbar user menu (data-testid='nav-user-menu-btn' -> 'nav-settings-btn'). Opens Settings dialog (data-testid='pulse-settings-dialog').

11_settings_team_organisation.notes: Settings dialog has 'Team & Organisation' section (data-testid='pulse-settings-section-team') showing Organisation name (Test Gym), Company Code (7D25055F), Team Members with current user.

12_settings_invite_button.notes: Invite button (data-testid='pulse-settings-invite-btn') available for owners to invite new team members.

13_backend_staff_api.notes: GET /api/organization/staff returns staff array with current user.

15_master_admin_login.notes: admin@gymfixai.com / MasterAdmin123! logs in successfully with is_master_admin=true.

16_master_admin_portal_switcher.notes: Master Admin sidebar has 'SWITCH PORTAL' section with 'GymFix AI' (data-testid='portal-switch-gymfix') and 'Pulse Fitness Pro' (data-testid='portal-switch-pulse-pro') buttons.

17_portal_switch_to_pulse.notes: Clicking 'Pulse Fitness Pro' navigates to /pulse with admin banner showing 'Viewing Pulse Fitness Portal as Admin' and 'Back to GymFix AI' link.

18_admin_banner_on_pulse.notes: Admin banner (data-testid='admin-pulse-banner') visible at top of Pulse portal when logged in as admin. Contains 'Back to GymFix AI' link (data-testid='admin-back-to-gymfix').
